product_metadata.title: Spoon Rests, Ceramic Make, by KooK, Set of 2 (Light Turquoise)
features: ✔️ Clean Counters: Goodbye sticky countertops and vanishing paper towel rolls. Mix, toss and taste away; these bright and durable spoon rests will keep your kitchen neat and tidy.
✔️ Wide Head: Designed to hold even large ladles and spatulas while cooking. The rest is just deep enough to make sure that saucy spoon stays put.
✔️ Bright & Durable: Add a pop of color to the counter! These utensil holders are crafted from heat-friendly, odor and stain resistant ceramic in 5 vibrant shades.
✔️ Dishwasher Safe: When it’s done catching all those spills and splatters - simply pop into the dishwasher for easy cleanup. They’re microwave and freezer safe too!
✔️ The Kook Promise: We’ve carefully packaged these Spoon Rests in custom polyfoam molds to ensure it arrives in perfect condition.
